summary.text: Shelly Hettleman is a Democratic member of the Maryland State Senate from District 11 who has served since February 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served in the House of Delegates from 2015 to 2020 and worked in government relations and nonprofit policy before entering the legislature.

paragraphs.text: Hettleman was born in Houston, Texas, on August 26, 1964, graduated from Pikesville Senior High School in 1982, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Northwestern University in 1986.

She was a legislative assistant to U.S. Rep. Ben Cardin from 1987 to 1990, director of government relations at the Baltimore Jewish Council, director of public policy at Parent Action, and program director at CHANA, a counseling and aid network for abused women.
She later worked as a senior planner at The Associated Jewish Community Federation of Baltimore and as campaign manager for Cardin for Senate from 2007 to 2013.
Hettleman served in the House of Delegates from 2015 to 2020 and has been a member of the Senate since February 3, 2020.

She serves on the Budget and Taxation Committee, chairs its Public Safety, Transportation, and Environment Subcommittee, chairs the Joint Committee on Pensions, and chairs the Maryland Legislative Jewish Caucus.
She chaired the Rules Committee in 2024 and 2025.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.
